description: Public TeamBlind posts, comments and error records. Each row starts with `recordType` (`post`, `comment` or `error`). Posts carry the channel, author company, engagement counts, timestamps and canonical URL; comments carry their parent post, depth, author company and engagement.

records.description: Dataset of posts and public comments. Empty fields are omitted; `recordType` is always the first field.
records.title: TeamBlind records
